name: balancevault
description: Secure account management platform with role-based access, onboarding workflows, and auditable account operations.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @balancevault/backend" "npm run dev -w @balancevault/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @balancevault/frontend && npm run build -w @balancevault/backend
